info.name: TableCheck API - V1 availability reservation_flags API

params.name: ids
params.description: Array or comma-separated list of specific reservation flag IDs to return.

params.name: shop_ids
params.description: Array or comma-separated list of shop IDs to filter reservation flags.

params.name: created_at_min
params.description: Search lower bound of created_at field (ISO timestamp).

params.name: created_at_max
params.description: Search upper bound of created_at field (ISO timestamp).

params.name: updated_at_min
params.description: Search lower bound of updated_at field (ISO timestamp).

params.name: updated_at_max
params.description: Search upper bound of updated_at field (ISO timestamp).

params.name: page
params.description: The zero-based page number. Used for pagination.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of items to return at once. Used for pagination.

params.name: reservation_flag_id
params.description: The ID of the Reservation Flag to retrieve
